paper_id: Salient Object Detection in Optical Remote Sensing Images Driven by Transformer
title: Salient Object Detection in Optical Remote Sensing Images Driven by Transformer
motivation: CNN只能在小感受野内提取特征,无法处理ORSIs中物体的多方向性、多尺度和多变类别等复杂场景
problem_framing: ORSI-SOD遵循局部到情境化范式,缺乏全局建模能力,导致检测不完整、方向不敏感
key_insight: 用Transformer替换CNN backbone建立全局关系,再对全局特征进行局部增强(全局到局部范式)
method_signature: GeleNet使用PVT transformer backbone配合D-SWSAM、KTM、SWSAM三个模块进行显著目标检测
evaluation_criteria: F-measure、S-measure、E-measure三个指标在ORSSD、EORSSD、ORSI-4199三个数据集上评估
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 传统spatial attention以全局方式生成注意力图,会遗漏有效信息导致误检背景;SGE忽略子特征间注意力一致性,不友好于SOD
evidence_for_taste: CNNs can only extract features within certain receptive fields
insufficient to handle challenging scenes of ORSIs
D-SWSAM comprehensively perceives the orientation information
channel shuffle operation to explicitly increase the channel interaction
complementarity between the product and sum
thinking_moves: 将local-to-contextual范式翻转,从全局建模出发再回到局部增强
针对不同层级特征设计不同模块(D-SWSAM、SWSAM、KTM)而非统一处理
引入方向卷积显式捕捉ORSIs中物体方向变化问题
cites_own_work: [13] Lightweight salient object detection via semantic matching
[17] Lightweight salient object detection via feature correlation
